name: Mahiro (Positive-Biased Guidance)
plain: Blends standard CFG with a pure positive extrapolation. The blend weight comes from how similar a compressed negative leap is to the merged result: similar means more ordinary CFG, dissimilar more positive leap. No parameters.
math:
L = s·x̂_c, U = s·x̂_u, M = (L + x̂_cfg)/2
normU = sign(U)√|U|, normM = sign(M)√|M|
q = mean cosine_similarity(normU, normM) (dim=1)
k = 2(q+1)
x̂ = (k·x̂_cfg + (4−k)·L)/4
